title: Vacation Override History Adjustment — Utilization Review Clause
content:
**Pharmacy Benefit, early refills for travel.** Repeated vacation overrides on a member's pharmacy coverage shorten the vacation release.

**Clause.** The override history adjustment counts the vacation overrides granted on the coverage for any drug in the last twelve months, the current one included: minus five days for three (3) or more, minus three days for exactly two (2), and nothing for one.

The adjustment is added to the vacation release days once the days on hand have been taken off the plan's most extra days supply; the release that results is never fewer than one day and never more than the plan's most extra days supply one vacation override releases.

### Table

| Vacation overrides on the coverage, any drug, last twelve months (current one included) | Override history adjustment |
|---|---|
| Three or more | Minus 5 days (a signed adjustment of -5) |
| Exactly two | Minus 3 days (a signed adjustment of -3) |
| One (the current override only) | Nothing |

### Cases (hypothetical)

- The current override and one other, for a different drug, eight months ago: two overrides, minus 3 days.
- The current override and two others in the last year: three, minus 5 days.
- The current override only: nothing.
